facts.fact: The NDPC issued a Notice of Investigation on 1 April 2026 into an alleged data breach involving Remita Payment Services Ltd, Sterling Bank and related entities, announced in a press release dated 5 April 2026; no decision is reported.
The NDPC cites the Nigeria Data Protection Act (2023) as the basis requiring digital payment operators to have adequate data protection measures, in a press release dated 5 April 2026.
The NDPC, under National Commissioner and CEO Vincent Olatunji, issued a Notice of Investigation on 1 April 2026 under its regulatory procedures.
